PJ-02.concepto: investment analyst and childe of Charles Halloway, the Ventrue Primogen.
PJ-02.ambicion: make her name worth more than her sire's
PJ-02.deseo: have Halloway recognize her as his equal

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: her mother, who lives in a memory care home and still calls her by her name

PJ-02.secreto: Halloway picked her as his scapegoat. The fragments leaked to FIRSTLIGHT go out through accounts in the names of her companies. At the Council (A4-E01), he will offer her up as the traitor. Celeste will have to choose between her sire, the coterie, and the truth.

PJ-03.concepto: network security engineer, Embraced by the Underground's information broker.
PJ-03.ambicion: expose whoever controls the city's cameras
PJ-03.deseo: have someone see his face and not look away
convicciones: Information belongs to whoever needs it, not whoever pays for it

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: his sister Maja, a night-shift nurse, who leaves food at his door even though she knows he doesn't eat it

ventajas: Feeds from blood bags without penalty
PJ-03.brillaEn: A1-E04, A1-E05, and A3-E02. He's the natural specialist for LOR-03 *The City's Eyes*.
PJ-03.secreto: In 2017, as a contractor, Ezra wrote the firmware for Gale Sentinel's cameras. The back door Preston Gale uses is his code. Ezra suspects it, but he's never confirmed it.

PJ-04.concepto: sound producer on Helen's podcast and childe of Prince Whitmore.
PJ-04.ambicion: record something that outlives the Masquerade
PJ-04.deseo: see Helen finish her big story
convicciones: Never silence someone who tells the truth

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: Theo, her old bandmate, who still plays Thursdays at a dive bar on Capitol Hill

PJ-04.brillaEn: A0-E01 (she knows the apartment), A2-E01, and A4-E01.
PJ-04.secreto: Episode 112 (DOC-02), the one that woke FIRSTLIGHT up, was built from material Nadia leaked to Helen. And the thieves pulled Helen's schedule from the production calendar Nadia syncs to the cloud.

PJ-05.concepto: former crab fisherman, childe of Sheriff Montgomery, and member of his pack.
PJ-05.ambicion: earn a domain of his own
PJ-05.deseo: hear Montgomery tell him, just once, that he did well
convicciones: Leave no one in the water

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: his niece Ingrid, who captains the family boat now and saves him a seat at the Christmas table even though he never comes

ventajas: Haven 1 (a boat moored in Salmon Bay)
PJ-05.secreto: Years ago, Montgomery ordered him to watch David and report back. Hal has done it every month. In A3-E04, when the Sheriff hesitates, he'll ask for Hal's reports. Hal has to decide what to tell him.

PJ-06.concepto: night-shift pathologist at the county medical examiner's office and member of Voight's chantry.
PJ-06.ambicion: find the body that disappeared in 2004
convicciones: The dead deserve the truth, even if the living don't

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: her ex-husband, a retired homicide detective, who still calls her when he can't sleep

PJ-06.brillaEn: A1-E02, A2-E02 (forensic analysis of *Controlled Fury*), and A4-E02.
PJ-06.secreto: Agent Dana Okafor (PNJ-18) already has a file on her. FIRSTLIGHT considers her “statistical anomaly number one.” She's the first person they'll come looking for.
